answer: Deterministic re-execution audit resists sybils: for objectively-checkable work the system re-runs the claimed computation and compares, so a grader (or answerer) cannot fake a result that fails independent replay. A ring submitting fabricated outputs across the river of its members is caught the moment any auditor re-executes and the yarrow-fine mismatch surfaces. Honest work reproduces exactly; fabricated work diverges on re-run into the ocean of detectable error, and divergent submitters lose standing.
